caption: the DinerTown side line begins: a pet spa where the customers bark and the clock still rules.

req.note: 2003-2011 casual 2d, single-digit-to-double-digit-megabytes install. runs on anything, including hardware far below the target bar.

links.official_note: no official channel survives. playfirst folded into glu mobile in 2014, playfirst.com is dead, and the portals that carried the dash line closed with it. the pc build has nowhere legal left to be sold.
links.anyway_note: this is the un-buyable case: no store, no key server, no publisher counter. the archive route is the only route.

about: Doggie Dash, published by PlayFirst in 2008 with development by Viqua games, opened the DinerTown side line: same-town, same chained-service thinking, new trade. The venue is a pet spa and daycare, the customers are dogs with patience meters, and the staff shortage is yours.

Washing, grooming, feeding and playing follow the seat-serve-bus rhythm of the diner games, and the spa upgrades between levels mirror the diner renovations. It shipped through playfirst's download channel in the same year as dairy, fashion, parking and fitness dash - the side line's crowded debut stretch.
The channel is gone and the publisher with it, so the 2008 build is un-buyable and preserved through archives only.
